name: Ancient Maya City and Protected Tropical Forests of Calakmul, Campeche
description: Deep in the jungle of Campeche, Mexico, about 35 km from the Guatemalan border, Calakmul was once a Maya superpower and rival of Tikal. Its Structure 2 pyramid rises over 45 metres above some 6,750 ancient structures. Today they sit within a vast protected tropical forest, part of one of the world's great biodiversity hotspots.
